title: mut.channel_diego_trujillo_pisanty
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — Diego Trujillo Pisanty (2024 · Still Image) — 'Blind Camera'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Neural-network hallucinations of Mexico City reconstructed from ambient sound — images that feel like a city remembered through its noise, granular and dreamlike. TECHNICAL HOOKS: Audio-FFT bins drive a particle field where loudness pulls points into emergent silhouettes (street, vendor, traffic) before dispersing — geometry: 2D point cloud over a depth-warped plane; motion: spectral magnitude as local attractor strength; palette: sun-bleached concrete, smog ochre. REF: https://lumenprize.org/winners-archive
